fact: The 2026 Investment Climate Statement says the government mandates, through the Data Protection Act, that data be stored within Senegalese borders, with exemptions possible and granted regularly, and that nothing restricts companies sending business data out of Senegal; the claim is not borne out by the 2008 Act's text and conflicts with the statute reports, so it is weak.
title: 2026 Investment Climate Statements: Senegal
publisher: US Department of State, Bureau of Economic, Energy, Business Affairs
